note: THE PLATEAU'S OUTSIDE PANELS (design_evaluation.md §8.2; read by main.cycle_monitor / main.plateau status --panel <name>). A panel is a FROZEN set of outside opponents (checkpoints of ANOTHER lineage or registry-named anchors, at an architecture main.h2h can pair with the run's), each scoring inside the 15-85 % band against the run's nodes when it was chosen. Every member names its file and sha256; a member whose file no longer hashes to it is REFUSED (a moved panel is a different panel). Add a panel by a declared rule and a ledger entry, never by editing a member in place: the panel's rows are keyed by its NAME.

outside_v1.registered_by: 2026-10-19 meter-build worker, ORCHESTRATOR ruling 2 on F-ED-26 (design_evaluation.md Decision record)
outside_v1.rule: every frozen checkpoint that is (1) OUTSIDE every run it is read against (another lineage, never trained again), (2) loadable at HEAD's architecture today, and (3) named in designs/baselines.json. Of the eleven baselines only `production` meets (2): the other ten are era_checkout_only. No Rust roster bot is a member: main.h2h plays checkpoints only (F-ED-26), and every roster bot already scores 0.89-1.0 against X26 and the X34 toy in their plateau regions (eval_results.jsonl), outside the 15-85 % band.

members.outside: another LINEAGE (the closing test's end-state seed s2005, a fresh 15M run; the lower-median seed by a stated rule) at HEAD's architecture (gen3_mon_tied_gain_v1); frozen since 2026-10-12, so it cannot co-move with a run's cycling. It is outside every rb_ run read so far (X26, X34 and its parent, X35's arms), and INSIDE nothing: no run's self-play pool holds it. It is NOT outside the RECIPE: it is the production recipe at 15M, so it measures progress against an early production policy, not against a different style of play.
members.in_band: UNVERIFIED: no row of it against X26's or X34's 200-380M nodes exists. X26 beat its own 2M node 0.93-0.97 by 30M, so against a 15M production policy its 230-280M nodes may score near or above 0.85. The first panel tick measures it; a member outside the band inflates the panel's SE (logit variance grows as 1/(m(1-m))^2) and the panel then reads UNDECIDED, never FLAT.

outside_v1.cost_per_check: the newest node's cell, 500 mirrored pairs = 1,000 games (1,000 pairs = 2,000 games at a candidate, plus the W-back node's top-up to 1,000 pairs once); the W-back node's cell is reused. Production-net games on rule 5b's CPU (3 cores) run at 1.2-2 games/s (design_x26_readiness.md section 2.6; X26's Tier-1 rows): 8-14 min a check, 25-45 min at a candidate. On the toy (X34) the cross-architecture cell's cost is UNMEASURED (bounded above by the production rate).
outside_v1.power: ONE member: at zero true gain and 1,000 pairs per node in band (SE of the Elo delta ~10 Elo), PANEL FLAT (upper one-sided 95 % bound < 14 Elo) has probability ~0.39 per check, ~0.15 at two consecutive checks; the design's ~0.95 assumed six members. So this panel makes TRUE_PLATEAU REACHABLE, not likely: a PLATEAU_BUT_PANEL with the panel UNDECIDED is its common read at a true plateau.

outside_v2.cost_per_check: SIX cells instead of one: the newest node's cell is 6 x 500 mirrored pairs = 6,000 games a check (12,000 at a candidate, plus the W-back node's top-up once); the W-back node's cells are reused. At the production net's measured 0.3-0.4 games/s on rule 5b's 3 shared cores (2026-10-20, a loaded box; design_x26_readiness.md section 2.6 quotes 1.2-2) that is ~4-5 h a check on this box, 8-14 min x 6 at the quoted rate. A toy (X34-architecture) player's cells are cross-architecture (the engine's second slot group): UNMEASURED as a player; as an opponent T* ran 0.7 games/s.
outside_v2.power: SIX members, in band (measured 2026-10-20): at zero true gain and 1,000 pairs per node, the per-member Elo-delta SE from the cells' own pair SDs is 10.5-12.3 Elo, so the equal-weight panel SE is 4.6-4.9 Elo and P(PANEL FLAT | zero gain) = Phi(14/SE - 1.645) = 0.89 against X26's P* scale (0.92 on X34's T* scale) per check; ~0.80-0.85 at two consecutive checks (checks treated as independent). The design's ~0.95 assumed SE(Delta) 10.2 per member exactly at m = 0.5; these members score 0.26-0.40, where the logit SE is larger. At 500 pairs (a non-candidate check) 0.65-0.70. ONE member (outside_v1): 0.34 at the same SEs.
